object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Not covered: a folder given as a path, and an editor side file among the selected paths; see the gaps.
object.description: Commit three files, then change one, add one, delete one and leave one unchanged, and commit. Separately, change two files and commit naming only one of them. Separately, stage a file in the git index from a git client and commit another path; and stage a new object file and the manifest from a git client, make one more edit in Mellon, and commit the document. Expected: the new commit holds each unchanged file as the latest commit held it and each selected path with its working-copy content; the changed file that wasn't selected keeps its content from the latest commit; the file staged but not selected isn't in the commit; the document's staged new object is committed with the rest, and the document has no uncommitted change afterwards.
